rules.growthDirection: Increase horizontal volume in approved shoulder, chest, back, arm, pelvis, thigh, and calf regions; do not increase character height.
rules.muscleLineProgression: Muscle lines increase gradually with growth stage and definition and remain minimal at Stage 0.
rules.styleIdentity: white body + black hand-drawn outline + simple hands/feet + slightly awkward loose drawing
rules.notes: MASTER image and the user-approved Stage 0 renderer are LOCKED. Do not replace them with player_main.png, graphite/geometric silhouettes, 3D, semi-realistic art, or a cleaner mascot redesign. Stage 1-10 remain reference-only until separately approved for implementation.
